title: BPP IdempotencyDomain (DESIGN.md §14.2): the server's canonical, inspectable idempotency uniqueness domain
description: The server recomputes this domain for every mutation and persists its digest with every idempotency row: idempotency_domain_digest = SHA-256(JCS(["bpp-idempotency-domain-v1", IdempotencyDomain])) carried as a typed DigestRef (see spec/README.md for the type-tag construction). actor_binding_digest covers the authenticated principal/Participant and binding epoch supplied by the channel, never a caller-selected identity. A request addressed to an old incarnation or Society epoch is rejected, not looked up in the new domain.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

operationId.description: Versioned BPP operation id from the frozen bundle registry (§14.6).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

class.description: Digest class per the §14.2 table; substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_id.description: Key id for keyed classes (raw HMAC keys and per-object salts are never part of a DigestRef).

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef (§14.2): every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash.
